visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with striking green-streaked hair and a soft pink knit top stands in a brightly lit room. She smiles warmly at the camera, touching her glowing cheek to emphasize her 'dewy skin.' A vintage-style gold clock is visible on a cabinet behind her. (2) The scene cuts to a split-screen montage where she mimics the poses of K-pop idols, specifically the 'neck pain' pose with her hand on the back of her neck. (3) Images of K-pop idol Wonyoung are displayed to serve as a visual reference for the desired 'water glow' skin effect. (4) The woman demonstrates common makeup issues by pressing a smartphone against her face, showing how unpowdered foundation smudges onto the screen. (5) She returns to her main position, gesturing with her hands as she introduces her summer makeup routine. (6) Close-up shots show her applying primer with a gray makeup sponge and then closing her eyes as she mists her face with a black bottle of setting spray. (7) She applies liquid foundation across her face using the sponge, creating an even, luminous base. (8) The central product, a Bobbi Brown marble powder compact, is introduced. She uses a black-and-white sponge puff to pat the powder onto her skin. (9) A series of close-ups show the application process, specifically focusing on how the powder interacts with her skin's texture. (10) She demonstrates the finished look by pressing a white tissue against her cheek, showing no transfer, while the skin still appears shiny. (11) High-detail close-ups showcase the physical product: a square white compact with 'BOBBI BROWN' text and the pink marble-patterned powder inside. (12) She performs arm swatches, showing the fine, shimmering texture of the powder under studio lights. (13) A before-and-after split-screen comparison shows the reduction in visible pores and oiliness while maintaining a radiant glow. (14) In the final segment, she holds the product near her face, smiling and talking directly to the viewers, concluding the demonstration.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with high-arousal female narration over a bright, rhythmic electronic pop beat. The vocal is clear and expressive. (2) A 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers as the scene shifts to the idol comparison. The music maintains a consistent tempo. (3) A soft 'thud' SFX occurs as she demonstrates the phone smudge, paired with a slightly comedic vocal inflection. (4) A bright 'ding' SFX marks the start of the 'STEP 1' tutorial. The BGM continues with a driving bass line. (5) As she uses the spray, a distinctive 'shhh' acoustic texture of a fine mist is heard twice, corresponding with her application. (6) A sharp 'pop' SFX accompanies the introduction of the Bobbi Brown product. (7) Rhythmic tapping sounds from the sponge puff are audible over the music during the foundation and powder application phases. (8) A 'sparkle' or 'magic' transition SFX plays as she reveals the 'after' look with the tissue test. (9) The technical description segment features a more informative but still energetic vocal tone, with steady synth-based BGM in the background. (10) The video concludes with a rising vocal contour and a final 'ding' UI sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate and promote Bobbi Brown's Marble Powder as a solution for achieving a lasting Korean-idol-style dewy skin look during hot summer weather without oiliness or transfer.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator extensively demonstrates, reviews, and provides a 'Recommended for' list for the Bobbi Brown product.
